status: Android connection clients preview. Desktop servers remain at 0.11.0 for macOS and Windows.

checks.phone: Android 14 emulator, debug and minified release: connect and server sign-in, sign-in kept across server restarts and an in-place update, locked-screen album playback with the foreground service held across track changes, media session metadata with branded disc artwork, favourite/shuffle/repeat controls, Back through dialogs and players, picture-in-picture from Back, Home and full screen.
checks.tv: TV-resolution (1920x1080, 320 dpi) emulator driven with D-pad and media keys, debug and minified release: connect and native sign-in, home feed with focus-driven hero, side navigation, film/series/album pages, search, settings, direct-play video with remote controls and progress reported to the server, background music with track advance.
checks.updater: Release discovery, SHA-256 and signer verification exercised against a local releases feed.

limitations: The TV client was tested on a phone emulator image at TV resolution, not a physical Android TV or Google TV device.
The final install step of a self-update requires the one-time Install unknown apps permission on the device and was not completed in testing.
Physical Bluetooth devices and multi-hour Doze on a real phone were not tested.
Media downloads for offline use are not offered because Lumio servers disable media downloads.
